name: simple_calendar_pro_get_events
intent: Get event titles for a date in Simple Calendar Pro
description: Opens Simple Calendar Pro, navigates to the requested date, reads the events shown for that day, and returns their titles only.
patterns: What events do I have on a date in Simple Calendar Pro
List my Simple Calendar Pro events for a date
Show event titles for a date in Simple Calendar Pro

steps.intent: Swipe from Home to open the app search
Type 'Simple Calendar Pro' into the app search field
Tap the Simple Calendar Pro search result to open the app
Tap {{event_date}} in the calendar to open that date's event view and read its event titles
